acceptance: flagprogress arms from config under the state root: with the campaign state active and no environment variable, a cycle whose working tree deletes no registry row fails; with it inactive the gate skips
no reader or mention of EVOLVE_FLAG_CAMPAIGN remains in code or config, acs.predicate_env no longer names it, and internal/acssuite.TestCuratedPredicatesReceiveEveryEvolveKeyTheyRead still passes
evolve campaign run sets and clears the campaign state itself (a test drives the command or its composition root), so the launch recipe needs no env export
ADR-0063 and ADR-0114 name the new path
acs.predicate_env and its bound are removed
fix: Represent an active flag campaign as config-as-code under the state root (a policy.json flag_campaign block, or a campaign-state file that evolve campaign run writes under .evolve/ and clears at the end), read by flagprogress from ${EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT}/.evolve instead of the environment; keep fail-closed quarantine when the state says active and HEAD is unreachable; then drop EVOLVE_FLAG_CAMPAIGN from acs.predicate_env and from ADR-0063, ADR-0114, the flag-campaign research doc, policy-config.md, runtime-reference.md, go/acs/README.md and the acssuite/policy notes. Once the campaign switch is config, acs.predicate_env has no key left to forward: delete the field, its bound (acssuite.forwardableKeys and the refusal warnings), its tests and its docs rather than leaving an empty forwarding mechanism.
source: console lane fix/acssuite-run-and-report, architecture review finding 1 (2026-10-01)
summary: The ADR-0063 flagprogress gate (go/acs/regression/flagprogress/progress_test.go:163) arms on os.Getenv("EVOLVE_FLAG_CAMPAIGN") == "1", an unregistered operator env flag exported by hand at campaign launch. Since ADR-0114 the ACS suite strips every EVOLVE_ key from the predicate environment, so the key reaches the gate only because the checked-in .evolve/policy.json names it in acs.predicate_env. A skip is what the gate does both outside a campaign and when the key is lost, and the key cannot be named in production Go (flagreaders/envtaint gates; flagregistry at FlagCeiling 26). Per the zero-flags rule, campaign state belongs in config under the state root.
title: Move the flag-campaign switch from EVOLVE_FLAG_CAMPAIGN to config under the state root
